player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: N ka pode [check] - bu sta ta faze un aposta.
invalid_move.amount_min: Suma di aposta / levantamentu ten ki ser ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Nada pa txoma; bu pode [check] envês.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Uza [bet X] pa abri; ka ten aposta ki bu pode poi.
invalid_move.insufficient: Ka ten chips sufisienti pa kel-li.

board.possible_actions: Bu pode faze kes kuza li: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Na showdown, tudu dôs ta ganha {card}. Pot é divididu y kada un di es ta resebe {split}.
